programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc:
Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on a fascinating journey to learn about different aspects of the lives of women living in distant corners of the world.Some of the points of the route in this edition will be India, Senegal, South Korea, South Africa, Israel and Mexico.The program participants will talk about their everyday lives and reveal intimate secrets to the traveler.Some of them will be truly moving.This season, the journalist will look at how the Orthodox Jewish community functions on a daily basis and how they celebrate the joyful holiday of Purim.He will visit a nursing home for women who were once involved in prostitution.Although this profession is legal in Mexico, women are not entitled to any benefits.The traveler will also meet teenage Karolina, who works almost 24 hours a day at a garbage dump, and in South Africa she will meet a girl who dives with sharks.These are just some of the many amazing experiences that await Martyna Wojciechowska
Kinnar have been present in Indian culture for four thousand years.They are called divine dancers.These half-people, half-birds appear in Hindu mythology and Buddhism.Eunuchs often ensured the safety of wives in the courts of Indian rulers.Nowadays, recently married couples and parents of newborn children seek their blessing.On the one hand, the Kinnar are revered during religious and spiritual ceremonies, but on the other hand, they are cursed and discriminated against.Martyna Wojciechowska visits Ram Kali, which runs a non-governmental organization that provides support to the Kinnar community and fights for their rights.

programs.title: Baggage Battles
programs.desc: Every year, passengers traveling around the world lose millions of pieces of luggage.Many of them do not come forward to collect their lost items.Smart Billy Leroy, self-confident Mark Meyer and eccentric husband and wife Laurence and Sally Martin turned lost suitcases into a source of profit.Each of them visits auctions where unclaimed goods, items seized by the police or left at airports are auctioned.Relying on experience and intuition, they try to gain possession of the treasures hidden in the bags.It turns out that they can earn thousands of dollars in this not very complicated way.
